annotations.title: Is it a Korean business day?

description: Check whether a date is a business day in South Korea (not a weekend and not a public holiday), and give the previous and next business days. Holiday data covers 2024-2027 (source: KASI; updated 2026-11-12). It includes substitute holidays and election days, and the 2026 additions Labor Day (May 1) and Constitution Day (Jul 17).

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for today in Korea (KST).

extra_closed_dates.description: Optional extra non-working dates (YYYY-MM-DD), e.g. company holidays.
